_comment: Rewrites for redundant p2-gen prompts. The batch had 25 clusters of near-identical questions — six ways of asking 'Could you tell me where the new X is stored?' — and a topical monoculture on top: 'office' appeared in 69 of its 208 prompts, 'printer' in 33. Meeting two members of a cluster in one mock wastes a slot and inflates the score on the second. Deleting them was not an option: Part 2 holds 293 items and ten non-repeating listening mocks need 250, so cutting 42 would leave no headroom. Each redundant item is therefore rewritten onto a domain the batch never touched — travel, HR, finance, customer service, manufacturing, retail, facilities, events — keeping its id, answer letter, difficulty and skill_tag so answer balance and media paths are untouched. audioScript is derived by the applier from prompt + choices, so the recording and the screen cannot drift apart.
